themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems to achieve research goals.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focusing on AI tools that help developers write, review, debug, and optimize code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles that explore various AI-powered tools and platforms designed to assist researchers in their work.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: This theme covers AI applications that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: This theme focuses on AI applications specifically used in the design process and its integration with research methodologies.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Content related to the creation and use of artificial user personas or data for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles examining the use and impact of AI chatbots in research contexts, including their capabilities and limitations.

themes.name: AI ethics in research
themes.description: Discussions and analyses of the ethical considerations and challenges associated with using AI in research and product development.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Focuses on the impact of AI on job markets, hiring processes, and the future of work, often citing employment studies.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Articles discussing how AI is being integrated into usability testing processes to evaluate user experience and product effectiveness.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
